description: This file defines the NotificationService class, which provides methods for managing notifications, notification requests, rules, templates, targets, and user settings via HTTP API calls in an Angular application.

classes.name: NotificationService
classes.description: Angular service class for handling notification-related API interactions.

methods.name: getNotifications
methods.description: Fetches a paginated list of notifications, optionally filtering for unread only.

methods.name: deleteNotification
methods.description: Deletes a notification by ID.

methods.name: markNotificationAsRead
methods.description: Marks a specific notification as read.

methods.name: markAllNotificationsAsRead
methods.description: Marks all notifications as read.

methods.name: createNotificationRequest
methods.description: Creates a new notification request.

methods.name: sendEntitiesLimitIncreaseRequest
methods.description: Sends a request to increase entity limits for a specific entity type.

methods.name: getNotificationRequestById
methods.description: Retrieves a notification request by ID.

methods.name: getAvailableDeliveryMethods
methods.description: Retrieves available notification delivery methods.

methods.name: deleteNotificationRequest
methods.description: Deletes a notification request by ID.

methods.name: getNotificationRequestPreview
methods.description: Gets a preview of a notification request.

methods.name: getNotificationRequests
methods.description: Retrieves a paginated list of notification requests.

methods.name: getNotificationSettings
methods.description: Fetches user notification settings.

methods.name: saveNotificationSettings
methods.description: Saves user notification settings.

methods.name: listSlackConversations
methods.description: Lists Slack conversations of a specific type, optionally filtered by token.

methods.name: saveNotificationRule
methods.description: Saves a notification rule.

methods.name: getNotificationRuleById
methods.description: Retrieves a notification rule by ID.

methods.name: deleteNotificationRule
methods.description: Deletes a notification rule by ID.

methods.name: getNotificationRules
methods.description: Retrieves a paginated list of notification rules.

methods.name: saveNotificationTarget
methods.description: Saves a notification target.

methods.name: getNotificationTargetById
methods.description: Retrieves a notification target by ID.

methods.name: deleteNotificationTarget
methods.description: Deletes a notification target by ID.

methods.name: getNotificationTargetsByIds
methods.description: Retrieves multiple notification targets by their IDs.

methods.name: getNotificationTargets
methods.description: Retrieves a paginated list of notification targets, optionally filtered by type.

methods.name: getRecipientsForNotificationTargetConfig
methods.description: Gets recipients for a specific notification target configuration.

methods.name: saveNotificationTemplate
methods.description: Saves a notification template.

methods.name: getNotificationTemplateById
methods.description: Retrieves a notification template by ID.

methods.name: deleteNotificationTemplate
methods.description: Deletes a notification template by ID.

methods.name: getNotificationTemplates
methods.description: Retrieves a paginated list of notification templates, optionally filtered by notification types.

methods.name: getNotificationUserSettings
methods.description: Fetches user notification settings.

methods.name: saveNotificationUserSettings
methods.description: Saves user notification settings.
